# Open Shaders API

`CSinterface001.h` is copied without changes from alandtse/open-shaders
commit `2ac27bd9906035e53f8f06dbf863763daa4db660`,
`include/VRAPI/CSinterface001.h` (GPL-3.0-or-later with the accompanying
exceptions). See `COPYING` and `EXCEPTIONS.md` in this directory.

revision 4 through SKSE messaging at PostPostLoad and uses `SampleWind`.
